page: Amazon Web Services inf2.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The system is powered by an AMD EPYC 7R13 x86_64 processor operating at 3.6 GHz, providing 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with two threads per core. System memory consists of 384 GB of DDR4 RAM clocked at 3 GHz, allocating 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered via six AWS Inferentia2 accelerators equipped with a combined 192 GB of total VRAM. The instance does not feature local storage, relying on external network-attached volumes, and provides a 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

Performance benchmarks indicate high multi-threaded computational capabilities alongside specialized acceleration. In stress-ng evaluations, the multi-core CPU performance reached 143,447.7, scoring in the top 10 percent, while single-core performance achieved 2,990.98. The PassMark encryption test also ranked in the top 10 percent with 109,323.7, and the overall PassMark CPU score reached 81,484.64. System memory throughput clocked 5,929.9 GB/sec in cached small-block reads, tapering to 133.1 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads. In machine learning benchmarks, prompt processing throughput reached 3,801.11 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model, 126.14 tokens per second on a 7B model, and 15.7 tokens per second on a 70B model.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, inf2.24xlarge concentrates substantial neural network inference capacity alongside heavy general-purpose compute without the expense of standard general-purpose graphics processors. A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of integrated local storage, requiring network storage architectures that depend on the 50 Gbps network interface. Given its six Inferentia2 accelerators, extensive vCPU count, and balanced memory footprint, this instance is suitable for large language model inference serving, deep learning batch processing, natural language pipelines, and large-scale parallel mathematical simulations.
description: Amazon Web Services inf2.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance engineered for deep learning inference workloads. Running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor offering 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs at 3.6 GHz, accompanied by 384 GB of DDR4 memory. For specialized acceleration, it integrates six AWS Inferentia2 processors delivering 192 GB of total VRAM. The instance includes 50 Gbps baseline network bandwidth but provides no local storage. In benchmark evaluations, it demonstrates top-tier multi-core computing power, highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core score of 143,447.7 and robust cryptographic throughput. It processes prompts at up to 3,801.11 tokens per second on lightweight language models. By pairing custom inference chips with heavy x86_64 host resources, inf2.24xlarge provides a resource-dense alternative to traditional GPU nodes for deploying transformer models, batched machine learning inference, and complex data processing pipelines.
